verdict.rationale: Aircall has a documented Public API, with an API reference listing endpoints for calls, recordings, transcriptions and campaigns. However, nothing in the evidence mentions a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger or other machine-readable spec. Human-readable reference pages and tutorials are an adjacent feature and do not count as a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
